newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Csopak plans to increase share capital.
newsitem.headline: Csopak plans to increase share capital.

text.p: Hungarian retailer Csopak will ask shareholders' approval for a capital increase of at least a nominal 250 million forints, the company said on Wednesday.
The company's plan, released in the official bourse gazette, is one agenda point of Csopak's annual shareholders meeting which will be held on April 26.
Csopak's current issued share capital is 2.2 billion forints and the company plans to place privately at least 250,000 new shares with 1,000 forint face value each.
The company's announcement did not give reason for the capital increase but said that it would seek listing of its new shares on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
On Tuesday Csopak shares closed at 3,090 forints.
